repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the JoI checks if it rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows the JoI incorrectly triggered the 'Volume dropped' action at t=300000ms because v2 (20) - v1 (0) = 20, satisfying the wrong condition.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR specification that detects a drop.
